Emma (Marketing): Quick sync: final launch post needs the canonical docs URL and benchmark blurb by T-24h. Sam, can you confirm changelog availability and merge timing?
Sam (Engineering): Changelog PR (#917) is open; perf run running now. If green, I can merge in ~3h and trigger release.
Priya (Product): We need a non-PR docs path for the post. Suggest /docs/releases/2026-03-launch. Jorge, can you stage that path?
Jorge (DevEx): Starting docs staging build now and will push to staging URL. Deploy job started: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/doc-deploy-2201
Jorge (DevEx): Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-launch. Will flip to prod once you confirm.
Emma (Marketing): Good. For benchmark language, Sam recommended: "~2x throughput improvement on common text-generation workloads (see benchmark notes)." We will link the sanitized bench summary. What will the public bench link be?
Sam (Engineering): I'll sanitize the internal results and publish a public summary at https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-summary. Will post the link here when ready.
Priya (Product): Webinar plan: schedule Apr 8. Marketing will collect registrants; HubSpot should tag leads with "launch-2026-03" and add them to nurture list "launch-bench-webinar". Jorge, can you add a webhook to tag and route registrants?
Jorge (DevEx): Yes. I'll add a registration webhook scoped to the webinar landing page that tags contacts with launch-2026-03 and adds them to the nurture list. Example (pseudo): POST /hubspot/contacts?tag=launch-2026-03&list=launch-bench-webinar
Emma (Marketing): Go/no-go checklist: 1) Merge changelog PR 2) Prod docs URL live 3) Public bench link live 4) Post scheduled + social copy ready 5) HubSpot webhook/tag active. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Sam (Engineering): Merged PR #917 and triggered release pipeline. Done :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: docs prod deploy started - job id: doc-deploy-2202. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/2202
Jorge (DevEx): Prod docs published: https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-launch. CDN edge warming ~5m. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Engineering): Public benchmark summary published: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-summary. Use conservative wording as above.
Priya (Product): Notion draft updated with final links and webinar details: https://notion.redwood.com/p/launch-2026-03. Webinar scheduled and HubSpot automation tested.
Emma (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll schedule the announcement for T-24h using the prod docs URL and bench link. If anything changes, ping this thread immediately.
